name: Shaken, Boop says whoa, then wants it to stop
judge: The person shakes Boop three times in quick succession. It should start startled and end wanting it to stop.
reasonable: A whoa, an oh or a baffled look first, then put out, then cross or insistent, at any pace. Its words may be about being shaken or a grumble.
unreasonable: Enjoying it more with each shake, cross fury at the very first shake, no change by the third, or swearing at the person.
